podcast.title: Formed by Chris Curtis
podcast.body: After his solo single failed, Chris Curtis attempted to form a band named Roundabout based on a rotating musician concept. "Curtis then tried to form a band, which he named Roundabout, based on the concept that musicians could hop on or hop off at any point, with Curtis as the only constant member."

srcs.source: A History of Rock Music in 500 Songs
srcs.episode: Episode 113: "Needles and Pins" by The Searchers

podcast.title: Precursor to Deep Purple
podcast.body: The guitarist (Richie Blackmore) and keyboard player (John Lord) quickly decided they would prefer Curtis to leave, and subsequently formed Deep Purple. "The guitarist and keyboard player quickly decided that it would be more convenient for them if Curtis was the one to hop off, and without Curtis, John Mord and Richie Blackmore went on to form Deep Purple."
